summary: Frontend-only re-test after fixes for cross-origin runtime error and UpdateModal blocker. /superadmin now loads cleanly with NO runtime overlay, 2-lock (Email+SMS OTP) works and lands directly on the SuperAdmin panel (Face ID step removed). All 8 tabs A-H render without tripping the ErrorBoundary; Tab B Monaco editor mounts; Tab F PWA button opens PWABuilder using safeOrigin (https://payment-admob-hub.preview.emergentagent.com); Tab H save-upi/save-rzp/save-admob work. Regression: Home route Legal Shield + Your Assistant chat -> app creation -> preview -> APK download button all work. UpdateModal did NOT block any flow. Zero console/page errors captured.
critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdmin.jsx is 533 lines with 8 tab components inline — split per-tab files for maintainability.
ErrorBoundary swallow logic is duplicated in getDerivedStateFromError + componentDidCatch; can be extracted to a helper.

TabPublish default version '1.0.1' will still trigger UpdateModal for users < 1.0.1 — acceptable now that modal is semver+dismissible+route-guarded, but consider seeding APP_VERSION from backend to keep in sync.
TabPayment: Razorpay handler creates payment record client-side without server-side signature verification — insecure for production, acceptable for test mode.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Runtime Error superadmin cross-origin frame' is FIXED. ErrorBoundary ignores SecurityError/'Blocked a frame', safeOrigin() wraps window.location.origin, and Razorpay is only initialised on user click (Tab H test-rzp). 2-lock flow is confirmed working end-to-end. Frontend all green.
rca of the issue: Original cross-origin frame runtime error was caused by 3rd-party scripts (Razorpay checkout.js in particular) probing window.top from inside the Emergent preview iframe, throwing a SecurityError that React CRA's error overlay was surfacing. Fixed by (1) global window error+unhandledrejection listeners in index.html that swallow 'Blocked a frame' / SecurityError, (2) ErrorBoundary in ErrorBoundary.jsx returning hasError=false for SecurityError, (3) SuperAdmin wrapped in ErrorBoundary, and (4) safeOrigin() helper wrapping window.location.origin. Verified: /superadmin loads with 0 console/page errors, panel + all 8 tabs render cleanly.
